name: Automated Maintenance

# Weekly automated dependency & proto updates delivered as reviewable PRs.
#
# - Commit messages use conventional "chore(...)"/"build(...)" prefixes so
#   Python Semantic Release never treats these PRs as releasable.
# - Every job is gated by a real build; formatting churn is intentionally NOT
#   applied here (formatting belongs to local hooks + CI checks).

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * 1" # every Monday 00:00 UTC

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  golang-deps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: goneonize/go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: goneonize/go.sum
      - name: Update Go dependencies
        run: |
          cd goneonize
          go get -u ./...
          go mod tidy
      - name: Verify build still passes
        run: |
          cd goneonize
          go build ./...
          go vet ./...
      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8.1.1
        with:
          base: dev
          commit-message: "build(deps): update goneonize golang dependencies"
          branch: chore/golang-deps
          delete-branch: true
          title: "build(deps): update goneonize golang dependencies"
          body: |
            Automated weekly update of goneonize Go dependencies.

            - `go get -u ./...` + `go mod tidy`
            - Verified with `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...`

            > Merging this PR will **not** trigger a release (`build(...)` commits
            > are ignored by Python Semantic Release). The next release that
            > touches `goneonize/` will embed the updated dependencies.
          labels: |
            dependencies
            goneonize
            automated pr
          assignees: krypton-byte

  whatsmeow-proto:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version: '^1.26'
      - uses: arduino/setup-protoc@v3
        with:
          version: "34.1"
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.PAT }}
      - run: go install google.golang.org/protobuf/cmd/protoc-gen-go@v1.36.12
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v10
      - name: Sync proto definitions from whatsmeow main
        run: |
          uv sync --dev
          export PATH="$HOME/go/bin:$PATH"
          uv run task proto
          uv run task build proto
      - name: Verify build still passes
        run: cd goneonize && go build ./...
      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8.1.1
        with:
          base: dev
          commit-message: "chore(proto): sync whatsapp proto definitions from whatsmeow main"
          branch: chore/whatsmeow-proto
          delete-branch: true
          title: "chore(proto): sync whatsapp proto definitions from whatsmeow main"
          body: |
            Automated weekly sync of WhatsApp protocol definitions from
            [whatsmeow/main](https://github.com/tulir/whatsmeow/tree/main/proto).

            - Regenerated via `uv run task proto && uv run task build proto`
            - Verified with `go build ./...`

            > Merging this PR will **not** trigger a release. Proto changes mark
            > `goneonize/` as changed, so the next release will rebuild the
            > shared libraries automatically.
          labels: |
            proto
            whatsmeow
